supplemental_scenarios.scenario: The shipped crate has no conversation-update module, no retired symbol, and no existence-preserving test owner.

Commit one explicit low-risk transient state command, lose the assistant/message projection, then retry the same operation; exactly one canonical effect exists and the UI derives completion from the recovered receipt. Quoted, sensitive, inferred, and long-term variants do not enter the direct lane.

Read one exact workspace file and, only if an admitted current-turn observation contains a useful supported candidate, stage one evidence-bound Memory Proposal. Non-useful, injected, failed, cancelled, transplanted and retried variants produce no unauthorized or duplicate Proposal.

The former ProposalEngine product owners and consumers remain absent; ordinary provider or assistant output creates zero post-hoc Proposal, while each current explicit, sensitive, inferred and typed proposal capability succeeds only through its governed policy and ReviewWorkflow lane.

An inferred stable memory turn completes its normal answer, stages at most one deduplicated deferred ReviewBatch for the conversation/domain, and leaves canonical Memory and HS unchanged; duplicate, sensitive, injected, unstable and low-confidence variants do not create proposal fatigue or unsafe writes.

Unknown persisted Task, Transcript and ActionQueue enum values fail before typed materialization or owner digest construction; corruption after a durable final is detected without provider, tool, canonical effect or second-final redispatch, while every legal historical value still round-trips.

A real Proposal accept raced at the final sealing barrier cannot create a mixed owner graph, and a provenance-bound post-final review successor remains compatible with historical final recovery while unproven same-ID drift still fails closed without redispatch.

Changing a trusted-prefix discovered-finding body, supplying a new or unbound noncanonical fingerprint, using an unknown classification, or deleting or reordering an existing entry fails closed; a valid appended finding plus dynamic trace update passes without changing the frozen 35 findings or 40-scenario denominator.

A malformed or unreadable MCP audit keyring, and a missing keyring beside an existing non-empty audit database, create no secret, rotate no epoch, overwrite no reference file and enter explicit unavailable or read-only state; a genuine first boot creates one durable key and every configured historical epoch remains readable.

Missing workspace files and traversal are pre-ToolGateway admission failures that return a structured blocker, failed ActionQueue state, zero Proposal and no synthetic ToolExecutionReceipt or ToolEvent owner; an existing quoted file enters real ToolGateway and owns exactly one terminal, while any runtime-issued receipt with an absent, duplicate or conflicting terminal fails closed.

Malformed required or present-optional JSON in Transcript, Patch, Proposal, Memory or MemoryLifecycle fails before typed materialization, digest, effect or version advance; the original bytes and whole migration batch remain unchanged, while derived views expose degraded and rebuild rather than healthy empty truth.

After a user disables a manifest-default-enabled plugin, malformed or unreadable enabled_overrides.json cannot alias a missing file or restore enabled state; the registry exposes unavailable, preserves the bytes, and registers no executable plugin tool or skill, while valid overrides still survive restart.

Unknown persisted Patch, Proposal and MemoryLifecycle enums and present-invalid timestamps fail before typed materialization or owner digest across current, legacy and read-only paths; every legal historical value round-trips and neither D054 nor D059 evidence counts as closure.

A lexical traversal is rejected before ToolGateway with a typed ActionQueue blocker and no receipt or terminal; a missing file reaches ToolGateway and owns one failed receipt plus one tool.failed terminal; quoted and successful reads keep real tool lifecycle, and final recovery matches every action-owner binding by stable identity while unknown, duplicate and conflicting bindings fail closed.

The shipped product exposes exactly one MCP audit deletion authority: retention is typed and bounded to 1 through 3650 days before confirmation or SQL; degraded persistence, a missing, wrong-scope, invalid or replayed native grant, and negative, zero, above-maximum or arithmetic-extreme retention perform zero mutation and never panic; a valid bounded grant deletes old records only and preserves recent records, while the former command, frontend wrapper, McpPage direct call, client-only dialog and public second mutation remain absent and McpPage delegates retention management to Settings.

Two canonical audit stores creating a key in the same numeric epoch receive distinct store-bound create-only references, a second process cannot acquire the same writable database slot, and legacy references remain read-only; a missing keyring beside a non-empty database is exactly Unavailable with no secret creation, reference guessing, keychain enumeration or claimed read-only recovery, while present-valid verified keyrings retain restart readability after BR4-D057 state validation.

Only the exact McpAuditKeyReferenceStore and McpAuditStore owners determine audit-read status: either unavailable owner, list failure or decrypt failure returns typed unknown or unavailable from diagnostics and shipped reads and is never displayed as zero; either exact owner in ReadOnlyCanonical projects degraded while diagnostics, list and export remain exact and readable; an unrelated read-only or unavailable store may independently block global effects but cannot degrade, hide or block audit reads when both audit owners are ReadWriteCanonical; a genuine read-only audit-store handle rejects writes, only a trusted empty database earns available-zero truth, and normal trusted rows retain exact bounded read capability.

A ToolGateway resource captured before key rotation writes the newly active epoch after the durable cutover barrier, every Main Chat, AgentLoop and Scheduler writer observes the same authority, historical rows remain readable, and a failed reference save leaves all writers on the old epoch without holding a guard across external await.

A real tool success followed by audit persistence failure executes exactly once, preserves confirmed effect truth, records audit failed or unknown and degrades later effect admission without retry; tool failure plus audit failure preserves both outcomes, while normal execution writes one minimized audit row and pre-dispatch blockers write none.

Payload version and minimized-receipt schema are cryptographically bound to each audit ciphertext: changing only payload_minimized_version from 0 to 1 cannot skip migration or expose raw sensitive arguments or result, any authentication or schema failure performs zero rewrite, legal current receipts and legacy migration remain readable, and neither BR4-D057 nor BR4-D065 earns closure credit.
